description: Evaluation zone with the figures split between the prompt and a retrieved benchmark. The recorded response holds two comparisons: the first invents one competitor's number next to two grounded ones (the whole component must fall, never just the invented bar, because a comparison with the awkward competitor removed flatters), the second is fully grounded and must survive the chain intact.

request.base_prompt: The visitor is comparing onboarding effort across vendors. Our onboarding completes in 4 days.

retrieved.content: Independent benchmark: Northwind Suite completes onboarding in 11 days and Vertex Suite in 18 days, measured on identical datasets.

data.content: All three figures come from the same benchmark run on identical datasets.

llm_response.reasoning: Operations role evaluating vendors: lead with the onboarding comparison and state the source of the figures.
